en: Convoy raid

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a Combine convoy of 3 or 4 freighters and oilers is due through this water under a frigate escort. Mission: sink or disable 60% of its tonnage. Execution: close unseen, strike the merchants and break off before the escort can pin you. Strike aircraft may be overhead. A raided lane stays cut for 10 days and patrols thin across the region.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Depot strike

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the depot hulk moored here holds fuel and munitions for the region's groups. A harbour garrison guards her and a frigate group lies close by. Mission: destroy the depot. Execution: come in from seaward, fire on the hulk and withdraw. An empty depot cuts every lane it feeds for 10 days.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Radar decapitation

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: this radar site fills the Combine's air picture and calls its strike aircraft onto shipping. A garrison and an air-defence group cover it. Mission: destroy the site. Execution: approach under emission control, then engage it with guns or missiles, or land a party by boat. Get clear before the group can close.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Agent extraction

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: three of our agents are waiting at a landing on this shore. A patrol and a frigate group work the coast. Mission: embark all three by boat and leave by the exit. Execution: hold under 3 knots within 100 m of the landing for a minute, keep quiet and lose no one.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Minelaying

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the Combine routes its groups through this channel, under a frigate patrol with a missile group nearby. Mission: lay 8 mines across the lane. Execution: run the line at 6 knots or more, within 5 degrees of its course, and slip away unseen. The field cuts the lane in the theatre.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Prize capture

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: one or two loaded merchants are due through this water under a frigate escort. Mission: board one and bring her home. Execution: stop her, come alongside under 5 knots within 200 m and hold for 90 seconds. Fire on either ship ends the boarding.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Defector escort

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: an aviso crew wants to come over and brings four passengers. A frigate group is already in pursuit. Mission: escort her to the exit. Execution: she stays Neutral until the rendezvous; meet her there and keep the pursuit off her. Losing more than one passenger fails the operation.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Feint

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the Combine is moving a frigate group through this area while another operation runs elsewhere. Mission: let them detect you, hold their attention for 5 minutes, then escape. Execution: use decoys and emission control to stay alive while they chase you.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Photo reconnaissance

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: new Combine hulls are working up here under an air-defence group. Mission: photograph 3 of them. Execution: hold each inside the camera mast's field of view, within 6 km and in sight, for 20 seconds. Stay unseen if you can.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Survive the hunter group

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a Combine hunter-killer group of the region's heaviest frigates has found SEXTANT. Mission: survive 15 minutes and break contact by the exit. Execution: use the weather, the islands, decoys and emission control. Do not fight the group head on.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Cutting out

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a Combine hull lies at her berth in this anchorage, under a garrison with a frigate group close by. Mission: cut her out and sail her to the exit. Execution: draw under 3 m, go in quiet, board her at the berth and bring her out under her own power.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Deaf ear

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the listening station on Ness Point hears every emission in Corran Sound and vectors strike aircraft onto it. A garrison and an air-defence group cover the point, and air cover arrives 10 minutes in. Mission: destroy the station. Execution: approach silent, engage the station and get clear before the aircraft find you.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Amble fuel run

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the oilers that fill Amble depot cross Corran Sound under a frigate escort. A Combine captain called the Underwriter commands in these waters. Mission: sink or disable three quarters of the oilers' tonnage. Execution: strike in the Sound, then clear the area. Without Amble the northern groups stay in harbour.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: The Kittering codes

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the crew of an aviso in Kittering harbour will come over with the Combine's air-raid codes and four passengers. A frigate group lies outside to stop her. Mission: escort her to the exit. Execution: she stays Neutral until you meet her at her berth; then keep the pursuit off her. Losing more than one passenger fails the operation.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: The Blackwater line

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the Fort Sallow task group sails through the Blackwater channel. A captain called the Broker has arrived with a gun frigate. Mission: lay 8 mines across the channel. Execution: run the line unseen at 6 knots or more and keep clear of the Broker. Mined, the channel bottles the group in Fort Sallow.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Total loss

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the Underwriter's ship, Indemnity, is working this area with a missile group. She runs silent and closes fast. Mission: sink or disable Indemnity. Execution: stock officers will wait too long on her; set the ship to fire first. Taken intact she is worth more.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Closing price

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the Broker's gun frigate, Commission, leads an air-defence group here. Her three guns outweigh anything a 400 t hull carries. Mission: sink or disable Commission. Execution: stay out of her gun range until you can strike, and use weather and islands to close unseen.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Sallow

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: Fort Sallow is the Combine's forward base in Corran Sound. Its depot fuels every group and air patrol in the region. A heavy task group lies inside, strike aircraft are 5 minutes out and a missile group 10. Mission: destroy the depot. Execution: strike fast and get clear before the second wave arrives. This ends the Combine's hold on the Sound.
